text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh! I'm gonna swap the pudding and the chawanmushi-noda!
Everyone's gonna be so surprised-noda~!

Whoa there, Windy.
Are you trying to pull another prank?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyaah!? H-Hishi Ama!?
T-This is bad, gotta run!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! No need to run away.
I've got no intention of lecturing you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Y-You're not mad at me...?
Even though I was trying to play a prank on you...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Windy, you just do whatever you want.
I'll be rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: A dorm head's job is to support what the students want to do. I'm not gonna get mad over something like this.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...T-That's impossible, nanoda!
Hishi Ama would never say something like that, nanoda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I pull a prank, Hishi Ama always gets mad!
And if I run, she chases me for real!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You HAVE to get mad!
Why aren't you getting mad, dummy?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A Hishi Ama who doesn't get mad when I prank her
has gotta be a fake, no doubt about it--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Not bad at all!
Get up, quick! Your world is waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! I knew it,
that Hishi Ama was a fake after all, nano da!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The real thing is waaaay scarier!
You're a million years too early to fool Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing through the impostor in her dream seems to have sharpened Shinko Windy's intuition.
As a result, her running has gained an even sharper edge.
